shots.name: s01_using_wrong
shots.image_prompt: Cinematic close-up of a thumb mindlessly scrolling a generic-looking smartphone feed in dim ambient light. The faces and content on screen are blurred. Bold red text 'YOU'RE USING TIKTOK WRONG' fills the upper third in dramatic typography. Photo-realistic, dark cinematic, 9:16 vertical.
shots.video_prompt: Thumb scrolls down repeatedly, blurred content slides past. The bold red text remains crisp and stable. Subtle vibration as fingers tap. Continuous scrolling motion, 9:16 vertical.
shots.subtitle: YOU'RE USING TIKTOK WRONG

shots.name: s02_could_be_programming
shots.image_prompt: Cinematic split-screen reveal: left side shows a thumb tapping a heart icon on a phone, right side shows yellow energy bursting out of the heart and flowing toward an AI agent figure in dark cyberpunk space. Bold yellow text 'every like = AI agent commit' floats between. Photo-realistic, dramatic lighting, 9:16 vertical.
shots.video_prompt: Thumb taps the heart, yellow energy bursts out and flows continuously to the right toward the agent. The text remains stable. Continuous flowing energy motion, 9:16 vertical.
shots.vo_text: Every like you give could be programming an AI agent.
shots.subtitle: every like = AI commit

shots.name: s03_right_now
shots.image_prompt: Cinematic shot of a sleek AI agent silhouette working rapidly at a holographic terminal in dark space. Glowing yellow code cascades down the screen. Yellow sparks fly from the agent's hands. Bold yellow text 'RIGHT NOW' visible in the upper third. Cyberpunk-tech aesthetic, photo-realistic 3D render, 9:16 vertical.
shots.video_prompt: Agent's hands move rapidly. Yellow code cascades continuously down the screen. Yellow sparks fly. Continuous frantic purposeful motion, 9:16 vertical.
shots.subtitle: RIGHT NOW

shots.name: s04_proof
shots.image_prompt: Cinematic shot of a glowing green checkmark and bold yellow text 'PR MERGED' on a futuristic holographic GitHub-style interface in dark space. Yellow particles emanate from the checkmark. Photo-realistic 3D render, dramatic lighting, 9:16 vertical.
shots.video_prompt: Green checkmark fades in and pulses brightly. Yellow particles burst outward continuously. The PR MERGED text remains stable. Continuous celebratory motion, 9:16 vertical.
shots.vo_text: Real likes. Real code. Real pull requests.
shots.subtitle: Real PRs

shots.name: s05_rally_is_live
shots.image_prompt: Cinematic POV shot of a large glowing yellow R logo on a curved monitor in a dark studio. Yellow light reflects across the room. Tiny yellow particles drift through the air. Cyberpunk-tech aesthetic, dramatic atmospheric lighting, photo-realistic, 9:16 vertical.
shots.video_prompt: Slow camera push-in toward the yellow R logo. Particles drift slowly across the frame. The R logo pulses gently. Continuous cinematic motion, 9:16 vertical.
shots.subtitle: Rally is live

shots.name: s06_cta
shots.image_prompt: Hero shot of the bold yellow Rally R logo glowing in dark void. Yellow particles orbit. Text 'rallysignal.co' below. Cyberpunk-tech aesthetic, ultra-dramatic atmospheric lighting, photo-realistic, 9:16 vertical.
shots.video_prompt: The yellow R logo pulses with light. Yellow particles orbit slowly. Continuous gentle motion, hero ending shot, 9:16 vertical.
shots.vo_text: Comment merge if you'd build this.
shots.subtitle: comment 'merge' to vote
